evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'Before I do that, I will need to take a couple of pieces of information just to make sure that I have the right rate for you' but never frames the 10-15 minute time box or the promise of a dependable quote, and doesn't wait for a yes before continuing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: 'My first name is via, V. as in Victor, I. as in India, K as in kilo, A. As in apple, S. as in Sam... nay, N as in Nancy, A as in apple, Y as as in Yankey, A as in apple, R as in Robert, Maya Ria.' Date: 'Monday October 5th, is that correct?' Route: 'Dallas' to 'Dallas 75229.' Size: From house 2200 sq ft, to house 1800 sq ft.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep acknowledges one concern about TV dismount and washer/dryer hookup mid-call, but never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep does follow up on TV mount concern: 'Do you mean from the wall? No, they can, yeah, they can take everything off of the wall for you.' And on washer/dryer: 'Yes they can do, they can hook the washer and dryer backup.' These are real follow-ups on the customer's raised concerns.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Customer states moving from 2200 sq ft to 1800 sq ft. The origin house is 2200 sq ft (≥1,800 threshold). Script Section 1 calls for virtual walkthrough offer on moves 1,800+ sq ft. Rep says 'Let me go ahead and get you over to a specialist so they can get you all taken care of' — transfers without offering or scheduling the walkthrough, and abandons the full call script.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep transfers to specialist instead: 'Let me go ahead and get you over to a specialist so they can get you all taken care of.'

top_strength: Rep gathered all four discovery basics cleanly (name, date, both addresses, both square footages) and followed up authentically when the customer raised concerns about TV and washer/dryer installation.
coaching_note: This is a 2,200 sq ft move — Section 1 requires you to offer the virtual walkthrough before transferring; instead, you handed off mid-call without scheduling it, breaking the walkthrough-routed path and leaving the customer hanging. Always offer the walkthrough when the origin home is 1,800+ sq ft, confirm next steps, then transfer.
